per_query.question: Welche Absatzmaerkte liefern nach Preisnachlaessen den hoechsten Nettoerloes?
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT c.country,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue
FROM public.customers c
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.country

per_query.question: Wie entwickeln sich monatlich Auftragseingaenge im Vergleich zu stark verspaeteten Zustellungen?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS monat, 
    COUNT(order_id) AS auftragseingaenge, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN shipped_date > order_date + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stark_verspaetete_zustellungen
FROM 
    public.orders
GROUP BY 
    monat
ORDER BY 
    monat;
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_created,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders
FROM public.orders o
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date
ORDER BY month

per_query.question: Zeige den Monatsverlauf von Bestellvolumen und Lieferverzoegerungen zusammen.
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_created,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders
FROM public.orders o
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date
ORDER BY month

per_query.question: In welchen Monaten steigen Auftraege, waehrend sich verspaetete Auslieferungen haeuften?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, 
       COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN shipped_date > required_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_deliveries
FROM public.orders
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM')
HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN shipped_date > required_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY month;

per_query.question: Welche Kaeufersegmente tragen nach Nachlaessen am staerksten zum Ertrag bei?
per_query.candidate_sql:
SELECT cd.customer_desc AS Segment, SUM(o.freight) AS Total_Ertrag
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.customer_customer_demo ccd ON c.customer_id = ccd.customer_id
JOIN public.customer_demographics cd ON ccd.customer_type_id = cd.customer_type_id
GROUP BY cd.customer_desc
ORDER BY Total_Ertrag DESC
per_query.reference_sql:
SELECT cd.customer_type_id,
       cd.customer_desc,
       SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM public.customer_demographics cd
JOIN public.customer_customer_demo ccd ON ccd.customer_type_id = cd.customer_type_id
JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = ccd.customer_id
JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY cd.customer_type_id, cd.customer_desc
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, cd.customer_type_id
